Why owners choose PEAK

Five things you notice the first week

01

Heat from three wavelengths

Every PEAK sauna is full spectrum infrared: near, mid and far, from 700 to 25,000nm. In the two- and three-person indoor models the heater panels sit 360° around you, and the Fuji adds a floor heater.

Indoor models reach 150°F. Outdoor models reach 170°F.

02

Red light therapy is included

Medical-grade red light therapy comes standard, not as an add-on. In the Fuji, Everest and Rainier you sit 7 to 8 inches from the panel, so one session covers heat and light.

03

Real wood, inside and out

Indoor cabins are Canadian red cedar or Canadian hemlock. The Fuji is red cedar inside and out; the Everest is hemlock inside and out.

The outdoor models pair a hemlock interior with a black space-grade aluminum exterior.

04

Plug in where you already are

The Mini, Rainier and Shasta run on a standard 120V/15A outlet, so no electrician is needed. The two-person Fuji and Everest need a dedicated 120V/20A outlet.

Outdoor models need a dedicated 240V outdoor-rated circuit and an electrician.

05

Free shipping and a 7-year warranty

Shipping is free on every order. Your sauna leaves the Ontario, California warehouse in a custom wooden crate, and the carrier calls ahead to set a delivery window.

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page. Peak Wellness Club is included free with every PEAK sauna.
